data.title: 莲华 · 绯红浮世万华的深凝
data.description: 漆黑屏风前，莲华端立正中，绯红浮世和服上的金色刺绣在微弱烛火中流光溢彩。她双手交叠于广袖之内，赤红双眸穿透迷雾，仿佛能洞悉一切前世今生。
data.location: dark minimalist tatami interior with subtle gold-accented black partition
data.action: standing tall with hands folded inside wide kimono sleeves, head held high, piercing crimson eyes staring directly at viewer
data.lighting: 万华镜结界漫天绯红纸伞与华美朱红行灯暖辉
data.promptProse: Renge stands with hands tucked inside her vermilion kimono sleeves against a dark screen, fixing the viewer with an intense, unblinking red gaze.
data.animaCaption: Ornate paper andon lanterns cast rich scarlet and amber warmth across Renge's enchanting kimono and hypnotic gaze.
